audit_scope.question: Independently verify whether short SIL horizons and simulator throughput explain zero evolutionary deltas, and test a full configured 600-second cap without changing safety limits.
external_claims_not_assumed: A 600-second match should execute in 3-5 seconds of wall-clock time.
maze_multiring_7x7_train_a has a 12-meter geodesic between the actual episode starts.
A longer episode alone guarantees a non-zero evolutionary gradient.
A 25-second maze_loop_o_train baseline should end in capture.

supported_by_repository_evidence: A capture on a 600-second-cap run is an earlier fixture terminal, not a 600-second timeout test.
A zero paired delta on one deterministic scenario and seed is consistent with a piecewise-constant policy/reward landscape.
A larger mutation sigma can explore farther, but it does not guarantee a different action, trajectory, or fitness.
not_mathematically_established_by_the_ex: The assertion that the sampled candidate and baseline trajectories were bit-identical is not established by equal terminal time and return alone; trace-by-trace equality would be needed.
A finite difference of zero for one candidate, one map, and one seed does not prove that the global fitness gradient is zero.

The selector orders applicable options lexicographically by priority, then urgency, then utility; utility weights influence choice only after the higher-order keys tie. The external audit's 'weights only act in SEARCH_PORTAL' statement is not supported as a general rule by the selector contract.

The mutation sigma is the standard deviation of independent Gaussian perturbations followed by projection/clamping, not a hard bound on the mutation norm. Sigma values 0.25-0.35 are unvalidated suggestions, not a derived threshold for crossing a decision boundary.

The maze_loop_o_train 25-second timeout is an observed result for one policy/configuration/seed. The proposed 48.3-second lower bound assumes reaching the Explorer's initial position and simplified corner timing; it does not prove that all possible captures before 25 seconds are physically impossible.

mathematical_contract.utility_argmax_switch_condition: For two options at the same priority and urgency, a switch requires (theta + delta_theta) dot (f_a - f_b) to change sign (subject to the configured hysteresis and dwell). The minimum L2 perturbation to the decision hyperplane is |theta dot (f_a-f_b)| / ||f_a-f_b||_2 when f_a != f_b; Gaussian sigma alone neither bounds the perturbation nor ensures this crossing.
mathematical_contract.paired_terminal_delta: If baseline and candidate have identical terminal sign and active duration, their discounted terminal reward s*exp(-beta*t) is equal, so that role's sampled delta is exactly zero. This explains an observed sample; it does not establish equality on other seeds/maps or a global zero derivative.
mathematical_contract.zero_sum_self_play: In one zero-sum match R_G + R_E = 0 for both candidate and baseline self-play, so the sum of the two self-play role deltas is identically zero. The role-swapped fixed-baseline comparison is therefore the appropriate implemented fitness comparison.

runtime_changes: Cache immutable topology adjacency once per graph snapshot.
Add deterministic Dijkstra shortest-path trees and reuse graph-scoped route fallbacks.
Vectorize batched LiDAR ray casting while retaining the scalar cast implementation as the reference.
Vectorize static-map ray casting for synthetic opponent extraction and preserve per-beam noise draws, including blind beams.
Limit curved-path beam checks to a conservative angular superset, then retain the original angular inclusion predicate and clearance test.
implementation.post_audit_safety_correction: A cached Dijkstra path could include UNKNOWN edges although the prior A* fallback accepted only OPEN routes. Cached paths are now admitted only if every edge is OPEN; a regression test confirms UNKNOWN-only routes fail closed.

route_search_strategy.search_algorithm: Deterministic Dijkstra trees restricted to EdgeState.OPEN in the SIL autonomous policy; each tree is reused for all goal nodes from that start.
route_search_strategy.cache_invalidation: The per-policy route cache is cleared when the immutable TopologyGraph snapshot identity changes. The nearest start-node ordering is recomputed once per policy input stamp as the pose moves; a new start node receives its own shortest-path tree. Pose-to-route corridor validation still runs before a path is returned.
route_search_strategy.cache_bound: At most two start-node trees are retained per graph snapshot using a small LRU; this bounds retained route-tree count while allowing a nearby alternate attachment node.
route_search_strategy.scope: This removes per-goal A* fallback searches and repeated graph/start preparation. It does not decimate tactical evaluation, LiDAR, curved-path certification, or the safety supervisor.

experiments.interpretation: One full-cap role-swapped smoke pair completed, but all compared outcomes were the same capture at the same discounted time. It is not evidence of evolutionary improvement and the single map/seed is not statistically sufficient.

independent_findings: The SIL accepts a 600-second episode cap and can terminate earlier on a captured fixture episode. A 600-second cap does not mean every episode runs for 600 seconds.

Measured local throughput is approximately 2.8x simulation time for these episodes, not the externally estimated 100x-200x. The asserted 3-5 second runtime for a full 600-second timeout is not supported.
The short horizons limited physical interaction in the earlier smoke runs, but extending the cap to 600 seconds did not produce a non-zero candidate delta in the role-swapped smoke test.
The 25-second compact-map capture prediction was not reproduced: the tested maze_loop_o_train baseline timed out.
A terminal-only discounted win/loss reward has a flat region whenever candidate and baseline share the same terminal kind and terminal time. More horizon alone cannot guarantee a useful gradient.

This P6.3 harness remains explicitly synthetic and non-promotable. The technical architecture specifies a 600-second total stage with a 240-second preparation interval, while this fixture runner uses a 0.15-second synthetic freeze; fixture results therefore do not validate official stage timing.
The fixture contract explicitly does not infer official ARRIVAL from synthetic goals. Only CAPTURE and TIMEOUT are supported episode terminals in this runner; this is not a competition referee.

external_audit_follow_up.safety_regression: UNKNOWN-edge route found in the cached shortest-path tree was not returned as an executable route.
route_cache_regressions: Repeated destination queries at one pose reuse a single shortest-path tree.
A changed nearest start node recomputes the tree for that source.
A new immutable topology snapshot invalidates previous route trees.
The route-tree LRU retains no more than two source trees.
external_audit_follow_up.raycaster_differential_coverage: Compared batched casting against scalar casting over four deterministic randomized maps (1,440 rays, 23 segments and 3 circles per map), plus tangent/parallel behavior, segment endpoint inclusion, exact max-range exclusion, just-inside-range inclusion, empty input, and non-finite angle rejection.

random_seed_run_review.selection: The candidate genome was excluded with hard_safety_or_episode_completion_exclusion. No supported finalist was produced; the baseline was selected and validation did not run. This is not evidence that a candidate was accepted with zero delta.

demo.explanation: The training fixture has open perimeter corridors and the Explorer synthetic goal is on the lower perimeter. A direct-looking perimeter trajectory is a consequence of fixture geometry and route policy, not evidence that the SVG renderer fabricated a path. The captured self-play demo is still a synthetic result.

determinism_check_after_route_cache_revi.interpretation: The route-search refactor preserved the recorded baseline commands, options, poses, timestamps, and terminal for this fixture/seed. This single case does not establish general equivalence for changed or unknown topology.

timing_after_route_cache_revision.interpretation: The measured throughput remains far below 100x. Wall time varies with telemetry, profiler overhead and host load; no 100x claim is supported, and a full 600-second timeout was not run.

random_seed_run_review.seed_semantics: The demo uses zero LiDAR range noise and deterministic policies, so changing its seed does not by itself make trajectories random. Training seed controls candidate mutations and fixture pairing; it is not randomized action exploration.

next_steps: Keep development searches explicitly labeled non-promotable and preserve held-out fixtures.
Measure repeated, scenario- and seed-stratified role-swapped evaluations under an explicit compute budget before running population-scale evolution.
If a shaped or intermediate objective is considered, obtain specification approval first; do not introduce unapproved rewards to manufacture a gradient.
Treat official timing, ARRIVAL authority, physical sensing, and G4/G5/G6 as blocked until their respective phase gates and authorities exist.
